incentives.description: Capital expenditure reimbursement of up to 20% on eligible fixed assets (hardware, servers, labs) capped at ₹15 Crore for 'Beyond Bengaluru' clusters (Mysuru, Hubballi-Dharwad, Mangaluru, Belagavi).
incentives.conditions: Minimum employment of 200 skilled professionals; facility located in designated Beyond Bengaluru clusters.

incentives.description: Lease rental subsidy of 50% for up to 3 years capped at ₹15 per sq ft per month for GCC operations outside Bengaluru Urban.
incentives.conditions: Must be located in government-approved IT parks or Tier-2 tech zones; valid for 36 months.

incentives.description: 100% exemption on stamp duty and registration charges on first lease or sale deed of office/lab space in Beyond Bengaluru districts.
incentives.conditions: Applicable on long-term lease or purchase of IT/GCC campus space in designated zones.

incentives.description: Electricity duty exemption for a period of 5 years from the date of commercial operations for new GCC investments.
incentives.conditions: Sanctioned connected load exceeding 250 kVA; continuous commercial occupancy.

incentives.description: Skilling incentive of ₹10,000 per local Karnataka graduate trainee hired into specialized R&D or engineering roles, up to ₹20 Lakh per enterprise.
incentives.conditions: Employee retained for at least 12 months; trained through accredited state finishing schools.

policy.policy_name: Tamil Nadu R&D and GCC Policy 2024-2027

incentives.description: R&D fixed asset subsidy of up to 25% on testing equipment, specialized computing clusters, and prototype fabrication tools, capped at ₹25 Crore.
incentives.conditions: Minimum R&D investment of ₹50 Crore or creation of 250+ full-time engineering jobs.

incentives.description: 100% stamp duty exemption in Tier-2/Tier-3 locations (Coimbatore, Madurai, Tiruchirappalli) and 50% exemption in Chennai metropolitan area.
incentives.conditions: Applicable on registered commercial lease of minimum 5 years duration.

incentives.description: Payroll subsidy for women and advanced PhD/Master researchers: ₹20,000 per month per researcher for 12 months.
incentives.conditions: Focus in advanced materials, automotive embedded software, AI, semiconductor design.

incentives.description: Green energy tariff rebate of 10% for GCCs procuring verified renewable power through open access.
incentives.conditions: Minimum 50% power consumption sourced from non-fossil renewable energy.

policy.policy_name: Telangana ICT and GCC Growth Framework Policy

incentives.description: 100% reimbursement of stamp duty and transfer duty paid on sale/lease deeds for IT/GCC campus space in Hyderabad Knowledge Corridor and Tier-2 hubs (Warangal, Karimnagar).
incentives.conditions: Single-window TS-iPASS approval; occupancy within 18 months of execution.

incentives.description: Industrial power tariff parity (rebate of ₹1.50 per unit over commercial grid rates) for captive data centres and AI engineering hubs.
incentives.conditions: Designated captive engineering lab with power contract >500 kVA.

incentives.description: TASK (Telangana Academy for Skill and Knowledge) co-funding: 50% reimbursement of cost of specialized AI/ML certification courses, up to ₹15,000 per employee.
incentives.conditions: Candidate must be a domicile graduate trained under state-partnered curriculum.

incentives.description: Special Tier-2 operational assistance: ₹10,000 per desk per year for first 3 years in Tier-2 innovation districts outside Hyderabad Outer Ring Road.
incentives.conditions: Minimum 100 workstations operational for at least 12 consecutive months.

policy.policy_name: Maharashtra Information Technology & IT Enabled Services (IT/ITeS) Policy 2023

incentives.description: Exemption from payment of Stamp Duty ranging from 75% to 100% depending on zone classification (Zone II including Pune / Navi Mumbai gets 75-100%).
incentives.conditions: Establishment in approved IT Park; compliance with Directorate of Industries registration.

incentives.description: Electricity tariff at industrial rates rather than commercial rates; electricity duty exemption for 10 years in emerging tech clusters.
incentives.amount_or_rate: Industrial rate parity + 10 yr ED exemption
incentives.conditions: Continuous operation; registered under Maharashtra IT Policy portal.

incentives.description: Additional Floor Space Index (FSI) up to 200% over base permissible limit for IT/GCC buildings upon payment of premium.
incentives.conditions: Subject to municipal town planning regulations and dedicated IT occupancy covenant.

policy.policy_name: Gujarat IT/ITeS Policy 2022-27 and GIFT City Special Guidelines

incentives.description: Capital expenditure assistance of up to 25% of eligible fixed capex capped at ₹50 Crore for mega IT/GCC projects investing >₹50 Crore.
incentives.conditions: Project with minimum fixed capital investment of ₹50 Crore or direct employment of 500+ persons.

incentives.description: Operational assistance of 15% of annual operating expenditure (leases, bandwidth, cloud) capped at ₹5 Crore per year for 5 years.
incentives.amount_or_rate: 15% opex up to ₹5 Cr/year for 5 yrs
incentives.conditions: Operational within Gujarat or GIFT City SEZ/Domestic Tariff Area (DTA).

incentives.description: 100% reimbursement of stamp duty and registration fees paid on lease/sale deed.
incentives.conditions: One-time benefit on initial commercial real estate acquisition.

incentives.description: Power tariff subsidy of ₹1 per unit for 5 years, plus 100% electricity duty exemption for 5 years.
incentives.conditions: Units operating in notified IT hubs and GIFT SEZ/DTA.

incentives.description: Capital subsidy of 25% on eligible fixed capital investment up to ₹20 Crore for GCC setups in Noida, Greater Noida, and Yamuna Expressway corridor.
incentives.conditions: Minimum investment of ₹20 Cr and employment commitment of 200+ IT engineers.

incentives.description: 100% stamp duty exemption on purchase or lease of land/space for GCCs in Noida and Yamuna Expressway zones.
incentives.conditions: Land allotment through YEIDA or NOIDA authority with bank guarantee.

incentives.description: Recruitment assistance of ₹20,000 per newly hired engineering graduate domiciled in Uttar Pradesh.
incentives.conditions: Continuous employment for at least 18 months.

incentives.description: Plug-and-play office rental subsidy of ₹12 per sq ft per month for 3 years in Visakhapatnam IT corridors (Madhurawada, Rushikonda).
incentives.conditions: Establishment of captive software or analytics centre creating at least 50 jobs.

incentives.description: Subsidized power tariff of ₹4.50 per unit flat rate for 5 years.
incentives.conditions: Designated tech unit in state IT parks.
